title: Ensure a minimum number of administrators are set for the repository
description: A repository with one administrator is one whose settings become unmaintainable the moment that person is unavailable — and whose permissions nobody else can restore. Administrators here are the people who hold Manage permissions on the repository — Project Administrators by inheritance, and anyone granted it — not counting Project Collection Administrators, who can administer everything and would otherwise make this pass on every repository of any organization that has two of them.
remediation: Project settings -> Repositories -> <repository> -> Security: grant "Manage permissions" to at least one more trusted maintainer, or add maintainers to the project's Project Administrators group (Project settings -> Permissions), which holds it on every repository in the project. Adjust the minimum with thresholds.minRepositoryAdmins in azure-devops-bench's config.
fixSummary: Grant "Manage permissions" to a second maintainer at Project settings -> Repositories -> Security.
